title: Eiffel Tower architectural perspective
creator: Earth Photart
usage: Website hero background. Both Pexels source assets permit website use and modification under the Pexels License. Attribution is optional; source credits are retained.
description: A cinemagraph based on a real colour photograph looking up through the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The photographed ironwork remains unchanged while a separate cloud timelapse is composited into the blue sky. The cloud footage is not asserted to have been captured in Paris.
edits: The 3024 x 4032 source photograph was rotated 90 degrees clockwise and resized to 2400 x 1800 without cropping or regenerating the architecture. A blue-sky chroma key protects the ironwork while compositing the cloud clip into sky openings. The cloud field is continuously remapped to show smaller, clearer moving cloud edges around the central aperture; there are no tiled sky seams. The cloud clip retains its blue gaps and white highlights, with a mild contrast increase and 5% of the photographed sky colour mixed in. Cloud playback remains half speed and forms a 16-second forward-playing loop with a two-second sky-only dissolve at the seam. H.264 MP4, 2400 x 1800, 24fps, silent, yuv420p, fast-start metadata, CRF 19. WebP poster uses the first composited frame.
presentation: Responsive cropping, blue overlays and simulated upward camera movement are applied separately by the website styles; they are not baked into the video or poster.
